# task-7189c874: repeat the source panel across the grid

## Validated rule

Identify full uniform divider row(s) and/or column(s) that partition the grid into equally sized panels. The bottom-rightmost panel is the source. Copy its entire content (including background cells and colored marks) by direct positional alignment into every other panel. Preserve the divider cells and output the original grid dimensions. Do not reflect or rotate the source panel.

Confirmed by a demo and an accepted test:

- Demo: a 9x5 grid had a full vertical divider at column 2 and a full horizontal divider at row 4, forming four 4x2 panels. Divider row/column remain color 3.
- Accepted test: a 20x7 grid had full horizontal divider rows 6 and 13, forming three 6x7 panels. Copy the bottom panel (rows 14–19) directly into the top two panels at the same within-panel coordinates; keep both divider rows unchanged. The output was accepted with zero wrong submissions.

## Application checks

2. Use the bottom-rightmost panel as the source (for a one-dimensional stack, this is the bottom panel).
3. Copy every source-panel cell to the corresponding local coordinate in every panel, including background values; preserve dividers.
4. Check output dimensions and all row lengths before submitting.
